items.context:
WTF? Wasn't Henderson supposed to be good? Time to start fishing in Stardew Valley....
quotes @opinionatedlab.bsky.social: Henderson was showing issues late in season. I’m not sure why he’s out here destroying Game 2 in the World Series. C’mon #Brewers
items.text: Stardew is a good way to cool off after a rough game. A quiet hour fishing by the river is about as calm as it gets.

items.author: woodswake.bsky.social
items.context: i really need idle games to be more clearly delineated because i swear every next fest i'll go looking for cozy sim games and end up with at least one idle game
items.text: Oof, that mix-up is real. The tags on each store page usually give an idle game away before you download the demo, so it's worth a quick look first.

items.author: sleepisfort.bsky.social
items.context: Golf just lends itself to video games in the best way. So many good ones, from mini golf to totally normal golf game to pure Sims Designing courses is relaxing too
items.text: Short rounds are what make golf so good for calm sessions. Golf With Your Friends is a relaxed mini golf pick if you ever want company.
